description: This Java class 'ProductionRunHelper' provides utility methods for managing production runs in a manufacturing context, including retrieving production run details, checking for specific tasks, and navigating linked production runs.

classes.name: ProductionRunHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling production run data, including retrieval, relationship navigation, and task verification.

methods.name: getProductionRun
methods.description: Retrieves details of a production run, including related products, components, and routing tasks, based on the production run ID.

methods.name: hasTask
methods.description: Checks if a specific task exists within a production effort, identified by work effort ID and task name.

methods.name: getLinkedProductionRuns
methods.description: Recursively collects all production runs linked via precedence relationships starting from a given production run ID.

methods.name: getRootProductionRun
methods.description: Finds the root production run in a chain of linked production efforts.
